summary: Iter130 — Admin operational infrastructure (4 new endpoints + 3 new admin pages + global search). All 17 backend tests PASSED. Frontend smoke confirms every required data-testid is present, audit-log row toggle expands, deploy-recovery contains zero destructive buttons (user's hard rule honored), global search dropdown opens within debounce window and clear button closes it. Regression suite (iter126 + iter128 + iter129 = 70 tests) still green. Zero React console errors across the 4 admin pages. Performance: every new endpoint averages <140 ms — well below targets. GO recommendation for staged rollout.

minor.issue: Uses existing `require_admin` gate which is actually admin-or-PM (legacy). PM tokens are accepted; only non-admin/non-PM portals (HR/Shop/Safety/Dispatch/anon) are rejected. Documentation/expectation mismatch with review spec wording ('non-admin token returns 401/403'). Not a bug — but worth pinning down whether PM should retain read access here.

action_items: (Optional clarification) Confirm whether PM tokens SHOULD be allowed on /api/admin/system-health, /audit-log, /search, /deploy-recovery. Today they are accepted because the shared `require_admin` Depends includes PM. If admin-only is required, swap to a stricter dependency.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_ops.py is well-scoped (~455 lines), all 4 endpoints are pure reads, regex is properly re.escape()'d before being used in $regex queries (prevents ReDoS and metachar leakage).

audit_log endpoint pulls per_source_cap = max(limit*4, 80) rows from each of 4 collections and merge-sorts in Python — fine at preview scale (~250 events total) but should add an index on `at`/`created_at`/`started_at` per collection and consider switching to a $unionWith aggregation pipeline if any single source grows past ~10k rows.
global_search runs 7 sequential collection.find() calls — could be wrapped in asyncio.gather() for ~3-4x speedup at no risk (currently 125 ms; not urgent).
_id is correctly excluded from every find() with projection {'_id': 0} ✓
All endpoints depend on require_admin (existing gate). No write paths added. Deploy-recovery is verifiably idempotent (test_idempotent_readonly passes).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all required data-testids present, no console errors, no destructive buttons on recovery)
